{
  "name": "the-last-harness",
  "version": "0.47.0",
  "description": "The Last Harness Pi package",
  "license": "MIT",
  "type": "module",
  "keywords": [
    "pi-package",
    "pi",
    "coding-agent",
    "agent",
    "developer-tools",
    "cli",
    "terminal",
    "typescript",
    "llm",
    "orchestration",
    "tlh"
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/diegopetrucci/the-last-harness.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/diegopetrucci/the-last-harness#readme",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/diegopetrucci/the-last-harness/issues"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": "^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "npm run build:runtime",
    "generate:pi-runtime-lock": "node scripts/generate-pi-runtime-lock.mjs",
    "build:runtime": "node scripts/runtime-typescript.mjs build",
    "check:package-versions": "node scripts/check-package-versions.mjs",
    "check:package-contents": "node scripts/check-package-contents.mjs",
    "check:lazy-import-boundaries": "node scripts/check-lazy-import-boundaries.mjs",
    "check:doc-links": "node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs",
    "check:release-notes": "node scripts/release-notes.mjs --check",
    "check:runtime": "node scripts/runtime-typescript.mjs check",
    "check:startup-performance": "node scripts/check-startup-performance.mjs",
    "check:installer-performance": "node scripts/check-installer-performance.mjs",
    "lint": "oxlint --deny-warnings scripts tests extensions protocol",
    "format": "oxfmt scripts tests extensions protocol",
    "format:check": "oxfmt --check scripts tests extensions protocol",
    "lint:sh": "git ls-files '*.sh' | xargs shellcheck",
    "test": "node scripts/run-test-tmpdir-guard.mjs --dot",
    "test:verbose": "node scripts/run-test-tmpdir-guard.mjs",
    "test:subagents": "npm run test:subagents:unit && npm run test:subagents:integration && npm run test:subagents:e2e",
    "test:subagents:unit": "node scripts/run-subagents-tests.mjs unit",
    "test:subagents:integration": "node scripts/run-subagents-tests.mjs integration",
    "test:subagents:e2e": "node scripts/run-subagents-tests.mjs e2e",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "typecheck:subagents-test": "tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.subagents-test.json",
    "typecheck:runtime": "node scripts/runtime-typescript.mjs typecheck",
    "validate": "node scripts/run-validation.mjs"
  },
  "files": [
    "agents",
    "config",
    "extensions",
    "licenses",
    "prompts",
    "scripts",
    "skills",
    "themes",
    "install.sh",
    "uninstall.sh",
    "README.md",
    "CHANGELOG.md",
    "docs",
    "!docs/brand",
    "!docs/local-development.md",
    "!docs/installer-performance.md",
    "!docs/no-unsafe-dictionary-investigation-2026-08-18.md",
    "!docs/releasing.md",
    "!docs/pin-bump-verification.md",
    "!docs/upstream-sync-inventory.md",
    "!docs/pi-startup-investigation-2026-07-15.md",
    "!docs/context-intervention-design.md",
    "!docs/companion-roadmap.md",
    "!docs/web-search-fork-release-cadence.md",
    "!docs/workflow-evals.md"
  ],
  "pi": {
    "extensions": [
      "./extensions/notify/index.js",
      "./extensions/annotate-git-diff/index.js",
      "./extensions/the-last-harness.js",
      "./extensions/subagents/src/extension/index.js"
    ],
    "skills": [
      "./skills"
    ],
    "prompts": [
      "./prompts"
    ],
    "themes": [
      "./themes"
    ]
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-tui": "1.5.2",
    "typebox": "*"
  },
  "allowScripts": {
    "glimpseui": true,
    "@google/genai": false,
    "protobufjs": false
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@tailwindcss/browser": "4.3.3",
    "glimpseui": "0.8.1",
    "monaco-editor": "0.57.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-agent-core": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-tui": "1.5.2",
    "@oxlint/plugins": "1.90.0",
    "@types/node": "26.6.6",
    "jiti": "2.7.0",
    "oxfmt": "0.75.0",
    "oxlint": "1.90.0",
    "shellcheck": "4.1.0",
    "typebox": "1.3.27",
    "typescript": "6.0.3"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-agent-core": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-codemode": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-mcp": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-schema": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-telemetry": "1.5.2",
    "@earendil-works/pi-tui": "1.5.2"
  }
}
